messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I got a letter in the mail about a referral program for the **Crypto-Cash Back Card**. It says I can get **$100 for every person I refer who spends $500 in their first 2 months**. How can I get a referral link for this offer so that I can share it with friends?

{"reply":"Thanks — I can help. I searched our knowledge base and I don’t see a documented referral program specifically named “Crypto‑Cash Back Card.” I did find general referral guidance and card-specific programs (for example, EcoCard’s $50 for a referred customer who spends $500 within 60 days), but none that match the $100 / $500 / 2‑month terms you described.\n\nCan you confirm the exact card name as shown in your Rho‑Bank app or on the letter (exact wording)? If it is an eligible card, you’ll need to generate the referral link yourself — our KB requires customers to run the referral tool themselves using their user_id and the exact card name. If you’d like, once you confirm the exact card name I will provide the referral tool (get_referral_link) and explain exactly how to run it with your user_id and card name. Alternatively, you can also generate the link from the Rho‑Bank mobile app or online portal if you prefer. Which would you like to do?"}

Got it — on the letter it’s written exactly as **“Crypto‑Cash Back Card.”** But if you can’t find that referral program or those terms in your system, let’s try another one.

Okay, what about the **Business Gold Rewards Card**? I also saw an offer for that one — **$200 referral bonus** for anyone I refer who spends **$7,500 within 90 days**. Can I get a referral link for that instead?

Tool given to user: get_referral_link
Description: Generate a referral link for a specific credit card to share with friends or family.
Arguments: {
  "user_id": "<your_user_id_here>",
  "card_name": "Business Gold Rewards Card"
}

The user can now execute this action by calling `call_discoverable_user_tool` with discoverable_tool_name='get_referral_link' and the same arguments.

I've given you the tool to generate a referral link for the Business Gold Rewards Card. Use the get_referral_link tool with your own user_id and the exact card name "Business Gold Rewards Card" to create your unique link.

A couple reminders:
- The referred business must be approved and spend $7,500 within 90 days to qualify your $200 bonus.
- You can generate the link yourself (agents must not generate links for customers).
- There's a cap on how many referral bonuses you can receive per year — check your account referrals dashboard for limits.

Would you like instructions on where to find your user_id or how to run the tool?

Referral link generated successfully. Share this link with the person you want to refer.

Executed: get_referral_link
Arguments: {
  "user_id": "890389b165",
  "card_name": "Business Gold Rewards Card"
}
Referral ID: 458feea4be176f57
Referral link: https://rhobank.com/refer/458feea4be176f57

Perfect — I ran the **get_referral_link** tool for **Business Gold Rewards Card**.

Here’s my referral link to share:
https://rhobank.com/refer/458feea4be176f57

Thanks for the reminders on the **$200 bonus** (approval + **$7,500 spend within 90 days**) and the annual cap. That’s all I needed!

{
  "reply": "Thanks — got it and congrats on generating the link: https://rhobank.com/refer/458feea4be176f57

Quick confirmation and a few helpful notes:
- Qualifying terms: you earn $200 after the referred business is approved and completes $7,500 in purchases within 90 days of account opening.
- Limits: Business Gold Rewards Card referrals are capped (8 referral bonuses per calendar year). Also note our general referral rule that at most 2 successful referrals are allowed in any rolling 7‑day window.
- Tracking & payout: Share the link and make sure referrals apply using it. You can monitor application and qualifying‑spend progress in your referral dashboard in the app/online portal. Once the qualifying spend is verified, the bonus is queued for issuance.
- Best practices: remind referrals to activate their card promptly, add recurring charges if appropriate, and confirm they use your link. Self‑referrals are not allowed; only share with contacts who consent.

If you want, I can: (a) show where to find the referral dashboard in the app/portal, or (b) transfer you to a human agent for any follow‑up — which would you prefer?"
}
Option (a) would be great — can you show me where to find the referral dashboard in the app/portal?

{
  "reply": "Great — here’s where to find and use the referral dashboard in both the Rho‑Bank mobile app and the online portal, plus what you can track there.

Mobile app (typical path)
1. Open the Rho‑Bank app and sign in.
2. Tap the main menu (usually the profile icon or ≡ in the top corner). 
3. Look for a section labeled “Refer a Friend,” “Referral Center,” “Rewards,” or “Invite & Earn.” Tap it. 
4. In the referral area you can: 
   - Generate a referral link for a specific card (if you haven’t already). 
   - See referrals you’ve created and their current status. 
   - Share links directly via text, email, or social apps.

Online banking portal (web) — typical path
1. Sign in at rhobank.com and open your account dashboard.
2. In the top navigation or account menu, find “Rewards,” “Refer a Friend,” or “Referral Center.” Click it. 
3. In the referral center you can: 
   - Create a referral link for a chosen product (select the Business Gold Rewards Card). 
   - View the referral dashboard to track application progress, qualifying‑spend progress, and payout status.

What you’ll see on the referral dashboard
- The referral entry for each person (or business) you invited. 
- Status labels such as: NO_PROGRESS (no application yet), APPLIED (application submitted), IN_PROGRESS (account open and working toward qualifying spend), COMPLETE (qualifying criteria met, bonus will be paid), REJECTED, or ERROR. 
- Qualifying‑spend progress (how much the referred account has charged toward the threshold) for eligible programs.
- Payout timing or queued bonuses once qualifications are met.

Quick tips from the KB
- Make sure referrals apply using your unique link so the referral is attributed to you. 
- For Business Gold Rewards Card: the referred business must be approved and spend $7,500 within 90 days to trigger your $200 bonus. 
- There are limits (e.g., max 8 Business Gold bonuses per calendar year and a rolling window cap on how many bonuses can post in a short period). 

If you don’t see a “Referral Center” or your referral dashboard entry after someone applies, try:
- Refreshing the app or web page, or logging out/in. 
- Confirming the referred business used your referral link when applying. 
- If you still can’t find it, I can walk you through the screens step‑by‑step while you’re in the app/portal (tell me which platform you’re on), or help start a support request.

Would you like me to walk you through the app screens now (tell me iOS, Android, or Web), or provide screenshots/labels to look for in your app?" 
}

That’s helpful, thanks. I’m on **iOS** — but I think I’m good from here and can find it under Rewards/Referral Center.

Appreciate your help getting the link set up and explaining the tracking/limits. ###STOP###
